observations.trace: The server snapshots and reinserts the last accepted PlayerInputTick with the retained intent on a successful capability reconnect. conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional discarded over-threshold impairment and recovery policy
conditional_findings.first_contract: The strategic-to-tactical fatigue transfer and recovery need one explicit rule for impairment already above the incapacitation threshold.
conditional_findings.trace: The strategic producer computes fatigue_ratio as daily calories divided by health-adjusted endurance times1000, then fatigue incapacitation as the square of twice the excess over0.5; this expression has no upper clamp in the inspected body. Symbolically a healthy endurance3 character at4500 calories has ratio1.5 and fatigue contribution4. If pain, blood loss, fear, hunger, thirst, thermal impairment and tactical encumbrance are zero, the strategic total is4. The connected-player view passes both total4 and fatigue4. Tactical projection subtracts pain, blood loss and fatigue from its starting base and initializes the single state.fatigue with4 and total with4. On a later successful idle condition update, the movement addition is zero, update_fatigue clamps that field to1 and applies positive stationary recovery before recomputing the retained total. With the committed source values55/16000 and hypothetical elapsed1/64 second, ideal real arithmetic gives total 1−55/(16000×64), about0.999946, so the local >=1 incapacitation predicate would change to the staggered branch. No player, strategic condition, source config, time step, world or product arithmetic was run.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: The example requires a living, otherwise unburdened admitted participant with coherent strategic data, valid viewer/limbs, no movement or active action, positive elapsed and this selected tuning; actual upstream mission selection, state refresh, time rounding, observer scheduling and other incapacitation sources remain open. The shown enter_mission reducer requires a living authorized member but its selected body does not itself compare incapacitation; other gates may constrain enrollment. This result is a source/ideal-arithmetic question, not observed recovery or proof a player can act. One can intentionally define the fatigue pool as saturating at1, but then the consequences for rapid recovery of above-threshold strategic fatigue need an explicit policy. The earlier e275 delegated Lens11 record already notes above1 maps to terminal1 and leaves recovery/policy open; its narrow once-only assessment is preserved, not overwritten.
connected_repair_dependencies: Determine supported over-threshold strategic fatigue, mission admission and desired recovery semantics across strategic, tactical and autoresolve, including the stored base and presentation cutoff.

Choose one authoritative general-fatigue representation or an explicit saturation/transfer rule; do not invent hidden parallel fatigue or additional movement-speed penalties. Preserve current pain, blood, encumbrance, injury and tactical transient-state boundaries.

Later authorized verification should cover at/below/above threshold, idle recovery, nonzero additional impairment, source projection, actual fixed/update timing, strategic and autoresolve handoff and displayed cutoff.
